methodology.aMetodologiaMindleE: The Mindle methodology is based on an interconnected system of four pillars that work together to turn intention into action.
methodology.oPrimeiroPassoE: The first step is to dump all your ideas, tasks and goals into Mindle. Do not worry about order or priority at this point. The system automatically categorizes and prioritizes, helping you clearly see what needs to be done.
methodology.comSuasTarefasOrganizadas: With your tasks organized, it is time to act. Mindle's Focus mode blocks distractions and lets you concentrate on one thing at a time. Use the integrated timer for deep focus sessions.
methodology.ativeOModoFoco: Activate Focus mode for a task
methodology.aRepeticaoCriaHabitos: Repetition builds habits. Track your daily habits in Mindle and watch your streak grow. Immediate visual feedback (habit bubbles) provides real satisfaction when completing actions.
methodology.crieHabitosQueDeseja: Create habits you want to develop
methodology.cadaPequenaAcaoAlimenta: Every small action feeds your big goals. Use Mindle to track progress toward your long-term objectives. See how daily tasks and habits connect to your bigger goals.
methodology.metaDescription: Discover the Mindle methodology: Organize, Execute, Consolidate and Achieve. An interconnected system for neurodiverse minds.

blog.entenderComoSuaMente: Understanding how your mind works is the first step to building a productivity system that truly works. For people with ADHD, the traditional approach to task management often fails because it does not account for the unique characteristics of the neurodiverse brain.
blog.oMindleFoiProjetado: Mindle was designed specifically to work with your brain, not against it. With features like integrated timers, immediate visual feedback and habit gamification, you can finally build a routine that works.
blog.focoProfundoEA: Deep focus is the ability to concentrate fully on a challenging task without distraction. For people with ADHD, this can be especially hard, but also incredibly rewarding.
blog.descubraComoUsarA: Discover how to use an adapted Pomodoro technique, create a distraction-free environment and use Mindle to track your focus sessions.
blog.habitosSaoOFundamento: Habits are the foundation of a productive and healthy life. But how do you build habits when your brain works differently? The key is to start small, track progress visually and celebrate wins.
blog.aprendaAsEstrategiasComprovadas: Learn proven strategies for building lasting habits with Mindle.
blog.metaDescription: Read articles and tips about productivity, ADHD and well-being.

help.comoFacoParaCriar: How do I create a task?
help.cliqueNoBotaoNova: Click the "New Task" button on the tasks page. Fill in the title, description, priority and due date. You can also add subtasks and categories.
help.oModoFocoBloqueia: Focus mode blocks distractions and lets you concentrate on a single task. Use the integrated timer for Pomodoro sessions and track your progress.
help.comoPossoRastrearMeus: How can I track my habits?
help.naSecaoDeHabitos: In the Habits section, create new habits you want to develop. Mark them as done daily and watch your streak grow. Mindle provides visual feedback to keep you motivated.
help.oPlannerPermiteQue: The Planner lets you view your tasks in a calendar. You can drag and drop tasks to rearrange your week and plan ahead.
help.possoSincronizarComOutros: Can I sync with other apps?
help.atualmenteOMindleFunciona: Currently, Mindle works as a standalone system. We are working on integrations with other popular apps.
help.ouVisiteNossaComunidade: or visit our community on Discord.
help.metaDescription: Find answers to your questions about Mindle.

community.aComunidadeMindleE: The Mindle community is a safe and welcoming space for neurodiverse people to share experiences, tips and mutual support.
community.conecteSeComOutros: Connect with other Mindle users on our Discord server. Share tips, ask questions and celebrate your wins together.
community.nossoForumEUm: Our forum is a place for deeper discussions about productivity, ADHD and well-being. Ask questions, share resources and learn from the community.
community.participamosRegularmenteDeWebinars: We regularly take part in webinars, workshops and community meetups. Stay tuned for upcoming dates!
